variants.headline: Business-start grant programme ends
variants.body: The grant programme {programme} for people starting a business has ended. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: A grant scheme closes its account
variants.body: Business-starting support under {programme} has come to an end. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Support programme reaches its end
variants.body: The programme {programme} has ended its support for people starting a business. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
